newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks fall after opening higher, bonds ease.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks fall after opening higher, bonds ease.

text.p: U.S. blue chip shares declined in early and light trading on Thursday after opening higher, while bonds also dipped.
The Dow industrial average was off 14 points at 7276, after opening on positive ground. Nasdaq also slipped, trading off around two points to 1371.
The long bond traded down 12/32 at a 6/99 percent yield, after paring some of yesterday's losses in early trade.
"Usually, when volume is down, we tend to see the market trail off," one trader said.
